messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate for inference-pool-usw-1 observed at 11:03 UTC. 30m spike, ~18% 5xx, autoscaling churn detected.
Irene: I'm on call and looking. telemetry shows kubelet restarts on several nodes in the pool.
Sam: I see repeated kubelet restarts + container start failures on node-usw-12 and node-usw-15.
Priya: Customer-facing: multiple customers reporting generation failures and timeout 503s. Support ticket INC-4781 created; CS triage engaged.
Ben: can you paste relevant kubelet/journal lines?
Sam: logs: 
```
Mar 15 11:04:12 node-usw-12 kubelet[1234]: E0315 11:04:12.123456 kubelet_server.go:842] runtime service error: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to start container: ... error syncing pod
Mar 15 11:04:12 node-usw-12 kernel: NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
Mar 15 11:04:12 node-usw-12 kernel: NVRM: The GPU has fallen off the bus.
Mar 15 11:04:13 node-usw-12 dockerd: Error response from daemon: Container failed to start: nvml: driver not loaded
```
Irene: sounds like GPU driver / hardware detach causing kubelet restarts rather than pure OOMs. any OOM killer entries?
Sam: some pods show OOMKilled, but the dominant signal is `kubelet` restarting every ~90s on affected nodes.
Ben: action plan (short): 1) cordon problematic nodes, 2) drain pods to healthy nodes, 3) replace nodes in cloud, 4) route traffic away from degraded zone. I'll take steps 1-3.
Irene: Priya, please prepare a customer update: region us-west degraded, working on routing failover and node replacements. ETA 30m for next update.
Priya: drafting now: "We're investigating elevated errors for inference in us-west. We are routing traffic away from the affected nodes and will update within 30 minutes." :white_check_mark:
Ben: cordoning node-usw-12 and node-usw-15 now.
```
kubectl cordon node-usw-12
kubectl drain node-usw-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Ben: drain in progress; pods are rescheduling to node-usw-3/7/9. autoscale-bot: detected pending pods -> scaling group.
autoscale-bot: scaled infer-pool-usw-1 from 10 -> 14 instances to accommodate reschedules
Sam: while draining I see `cuda: watchdog reset` and device detach in dmesg; likely kernel/driver regression from last node image. grep of dmesg shows same pattern across nodes.
Irene: any recent node-image rollouts?
Deploy-bot: cluster-autoupdate completed for node-image image-rt-2026-03-14@sha256:abcdef yesterday at 03:12 UTC
Ben: yes, that image rolled last night. correlation is suspicious.
Irene: mitigation: pause the image rollout and mark image as suspect. Sam — grep for dmesg across nodes and collect kernel + driver versions.
Sam: running quick scan:
```
for n in node-usw-*; do ssh $n 'dmesg | tail -n 40' | grep -Ei 'NVRM|watchdog|GPU has fallen off the bus' && echo $n; done
```
Sam: matches found on node-usw-12, node-usw-15, node-usw-18.
Ben: initiating cloud reset for node-usw-12 to see if transient; if reset fails, we'll repro and replace.
```
gcloud compute instances reset node-usw-12 --zone=us-west2-a
```
Irene: I'm handing primary to Ben (I need to join an executive call). Ben, you're lead — I'll remain available.
Ben: ack, taking over. @Sam please do runtime deep dive and open infra-runtime issue.
Sam: collecting full logs, kernel versions, nvidia-smi outputs, and will create an issue with repro steps. early notes: `nvidia 525.105` + kernel `6.1.0-rt` on suspect nodes.
Priya: posted customer update and added CS links to INC-4781. Two customers requested emergency region switchover; CS helped move their workloads to us-east.
Ben: node-usw-12 rejoined healthy after reset; kubelet stabilized. node-usw-15 still flapping so I cordoned and left it cordoned for replacement.
autoscale-bot: new node node-usw-20 joined and passed readiness probes
Ben: temporarily marking us-west zone as degraded in routing config to divert traffic to us-east/eu for critical customers.
Irene: metrics: 5xx rate dropped from ~18% -> ~2% after drains/scaleup/failover. P99 latency improved but still elevated (~2.1s) due to reschedules.
Priya: CS report: 9 customers impacted; 2 customers had latency spikes >3s. No data loss. No SLA breaches detected yet; we continue to monitor.
Sam: follow-ups captured: 1) revert node-image rollout and reproduce in staging, 2) add GPU driver init check to node bake e2e, 3) add rollout guard to limit infer-pool churn to <=10% at once.
Ben: opened infra-runtime issue #342: "node-image kernel/driver regression causing GPU detach & kubelet restarts" with logs, dmesg, and repro steps.
Irene: status update for timeline: incident mitigated operationally, follow-ups ongoing. handing off documentation and timeline tasks: @Sam to author postmortem, @Irene to own timeline and customer timeline notes. :hammer_and_wrench:
Ben: handing off to @Sam for postmortem draft; I'll stay on for infra follow-ups.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. Next automated update in 60m.
